$comment: Traceability: ADR-PROJ023-001 (Hybrid B+C), Phase 5 Red-Blue Composition (IP-5), Phase 5 Handoff Protocols (SV-08..SV-11, RV-05, RV-06), SEC-MAJOR-3 resolution. Data sanitization rules: ATT&CK ID regex ^T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?$, SHA-256 regex ^[a-f0-9]{64}$, paths must not contain '..' and must resolve within work/ subtree.
title: Red-Blue Exchange Envelope (RBEE) v1
description: Cross-skill data contract for transferring red team engagement findings to blue team detection agents. The RBEE is a handoff-v2 extension that normalizes findings into a format blue-team agents can safely consume. All artifact paths are metadata references only -- blue-team agents MUST NOT Read artifact content directly into context. Trust level is always adversary-tainted for red-to-blue transfer.

finding_id.description: Engagement-scoped finding identifier. Format: F-{NNN}. Unique within the engagement.

engagement_id.description: Identifier of the red team engagement that produced this finding. Used to locate artifacts in work/red-team/engagements/{engagement-id}/.

finding_title.description: Human-readable descriptive title for this finding.

attack_technique.description: ATT&CK technique anchor for this finding. Provides the join key for D3FEND countermeasure mapping.

id.description: ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID. Format: T{NNNN} or T{NNNN}.{NNN}.

subtechnique.description: Optional sub-technique ID when the finding maps to a specific sub-technique. MUST be a child of the technique in the 'id' field.

tactic.description: Parent ATT&CK tactic ID. Format: TA{NNNN}.

cvss_score.description: CVSS base score as a decimal string. Range: 0.0 to 10.0.

cvss_vector.description: CVSS vector string (CVSS v3.1 or v4.0). Optional but recommended when cvss_score is present.

qualitative.description: Qualitative severity classification. Required even when cvss_score is present.

file_indicators.description: File-based indicators of compromise. Each entry drives YARA rule creation in blue-ioc.

type.description: Indicator type. hash-sha256 is preferred for detection precision.

value.description: Indicator value. For hash-sha256: 64 lowercase hex characters. For filename/filepath: pattern string. Maximum 2000 characters per data sanitization rule.

context.description: Observation context. MUST carry [ADVERSARY-TAINTED] prefix per trust-boundary framing rule when loaded in blue-team agent context. Maximum 2000 characters.

value.description: SHA-256 hash: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

network_indicators.description: Network-based indicators of compromise. Each entry drives Suricata/Sigma rule creation in blue-ioc.

value.description: Indicator value. Domain names, IP addresses, URLs, User-Agent strings, etc. Maximum 2000 characters per data sanitization rule. MUST carry [ADVERSARY-TAINTED] prefix when displayed as free-text in blue-team agent context.

port.description: Associated network port (optional). Applicable to ip and domain types.

protocol.description: Network protocol associated with this indicator.

context.description: Observation context for this network indicator. Maximum 2000 characters.

behavioral_indicators.description: Behavioral patterns and TTPs. Each entry drives Sigma rule creation in blue-ioc.

type.description: Behavioral indicator type. Maps to corresponding Sigma rule category.

description.description: What the behavior looks like. Maximum 2000 characters per data sanitization rule.

detection_logic.description: Pseudocode or natural-language detection criteria for this behavior. Used by blue-ioc to author Sigma rules. Maximum 2000 characters.

parent_process.description: Parent process name or pattern (for process-creation type).

command_line_pattern.description: Command-line argument pattern (for process-creation and command-execution types).

taint_level.description: Taint classification for the finding and its artifacts. adversary-produced: artifact was produced by attacker tooling or code. adversary-controlled: artifact is controlled by (but not created by) attacker tools. engagement-generated: artifact was generated during the engagement by the red team operator.

artifacts.description: References to engagement artifacts. Contains metadata only -- paths and hashes -- never artifact content. Blue-team agents MUST NOT Read these paths directly into context; use tool-mediated analysis (YARA-X scanning, hash extraction) instead.

items.description: Single artifact reference with metadata for trust-boundary-compliant processing.

path.description: Filesystem path to the artifact. MUST resolve within work/ subtree. MUST NOT contain '..' path traversal sequences. Validated at envelope creation time by main context.

sha256_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact file. 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Used for integrity verification without loading artifact content into context.

taint_level.description: Taint classification for this specific artifact. Overrides envelope-level taint_level for individual artifacts where the taint differs.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this artifact is and what it demonstrates. Maximum 2000 characters.

indicator_summary.description: Summary counts for quick routing decisions -- which detection rule types blue-ioc should produce.

total_indicator_count.description: Sum of all indicator counts. Must equal file_indicator_count + network_indicator_count + behavioral_indicator_count.

d3fend_countermeasures.description: Optional ATT&CK-to-D3FEND mapping. Populated by blue-d3fend when this finding is processed through the gap analysis pipeline. Used to link offensive findings to defensive countermeasures.

d3fend_id.description: D3FEND countermeasure ID. Format: D3-{XX} to D3-{XXXXX}.

d3fend_tactic.description: D3FEND tactic this countermeasure belongs to.

confidence_tier.description: Coverage confidence level. Verified: backed by Tier A tool. Partial: Tier B/C mixed. Unverified: requires user-deployed Tier C infrastructure.

detection_rule_ref.description: Optional reference to the detection rule produced for this countermeasure. File path relative to work/.

requested_rule_types.description: Detection rule types that blue-ioc should produce for this finding. Derived from indicator types present.

type.description: Rule type to produce. stix-indicator is always requested. yara when file_indicator_count > 0. sigma when behavioral_indicator_count > 0. suricata when network_indicator_count > 0.

trigger_condition.description: Condition that triggered this rule type request.

target_agent.description: Blue-team agent that should produce this rule type.

trust_classification.description: Trust boundary classification for this cross-skill envelope. Enforces SEC-MAJOR-3 resolution: Zone 1-to-Zone 1 transfer with asymmetric taint propagation.

source_skill.description: Originating skill. Always /red-team for RBEE envelopes.

target_skill.description: Destination skill. Always /blue-team for RBEE envelopes.

source_zone.description: Security zone classification. Red-team output is Zone 1 (Analysis) when produced by red-reporter.

taint_level.description: Trust level for content crossing the red-to-blue boundary. Always adversary-modeled: red-team output models adversary behavior regardless of which agent produced it.

validation_required.description: Validation steps the receiving skill MUST perform before processing this envelope.
default: STIX schema validation on all structured indicators
File path existence check on all artifact references
No direct Read of adversary-tainted artifacts into agent context

data_classification.description: Sensitivity classification for this envelope payload.

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol marking per FIRST TLP v2.0. RBEE envelopes are typically TLP:AMBER (engagement-restricted).

contains_credentials.description: Whether any artifact may contain credential material. When true, receiving skill MUST apply credential filter pipeline before loading artifact content into context.

engagement_scope_id.description: Reference to the governing engagement scope document. All cross-skill handoffs MUST operate within a shared engagement scope.

retention_policy.description: How long this envelope and its artifacts should be retained.

envelope_metadata.description: Administrative metadata for envelope tracking and session resumption.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the envelope was created by main context.

created_by.description: Agent or process that created the envelope.

purple_iteration.description: Purple team loop iteration this finding serves. Null for standalone (non-purple-team) engagements.

session_id.description: Session identifier from which this envelope was produced.
